# Brian Phillips — AI and software consulting / Unipheas

> Practical AI for business and hands-on software development from concept
> through production release. Mobile app development is Brian's specialty.

## Services

- AI for business: select useful tasks, connect company knowledge and tools,
  build and test workflows, and train owners or teams to use and review them.
  Example applications include meeting follow-ups, knowledge retrieval,
  recurring reports, and software development routines.
- Mobile apps: product planning, user flows, prototypes, native iOS and
  cross-platform React Native development, backend integration, device testing,
  App Store and Google Play release support, and ongoing improvements.
- Software and technical guidance: web apps, internal tools, APIs, integrations,
  cloud infrastructure, existing system improvements, and technical direction.

Brian works directly with clients and can collaborate with an existing team.
New ideas, prototypes, and existing products are all within scope. Engagements
start with a conversation; scope, fee, and timing are agreed before paid work.

## Approach

Plan, design, build, test, release, and improve. AI is both a service offered to
clients and a tool in Brian's own engineering process. AI output is reviewed;
access, actions, running costs, and approval points are agreed for each workflow.
Relevant accounts, code, and documentation should remain under client control.

## Experience

Brian has 15+ years across software development and engineering leadership,
with a specialty in mobile apps and experience across the full development
process. Public work includes maintaining and contributing to MAVSDK-Swift.

## Optional Engineering Rescue Audit

For broader questions about existing software ownership, delivery, costs, and
risks: $12,500 USD fixed fee, 2–3 weeks, independent and read-only by default.
Deliverables include a risk briefing, ownership map, findings, and a prioritized
90-day roadmap. The audit is not required for every engagement. Implementation
and ongoing work are agreed separately.
